'''Plate I''' — ''the Banner-lands, general chart'' — is the canonical map of the known world, drawn after the charts of the Wave-Reader archive in the year 396 A.U. Its motto is the series' own: ''"The map ends where the truth begins."''

The plate follows the Wave-Reader rule: the rivers are drawn but never named ("draw the water, omit the quarrel"), and where the sources disagree, the disagreement is drawn. A scale bar notes: ''a hundred leagues, more or less — no two charts agree.''
